correctness.rationale: Graph vertices are ten 2-subsets of [5], edges join disjoint pairs, and faces are those vertex subsets inducing acyclic graphs. A fixed geometric point is constant on whole H-orbits of those graph vertices; the admissible orbit-face simplicial complex is PL-homeomorphic to the strict fixed locus. The source verifier independently checks all 1024 induced-vertex subsets by DFS and union-find, enumerates all 120 S5 permutations, builds all 156 subgroups and 19 conjugacy classes, and verifies each elementary free-face collapse. The nontrivial double-transposition residual consists of six vertices, thirteen edges, ten triangles; five star edges give a spanning tree and eight triangle witnesses eliminate all other pi1 generators, so it is simply connected; χ=3 implies H2=Z² and wedge two S2 via 2-dimensional Whitehead/Hurewicz. Independently generated all 156 groups and computed exact orbit-face F2 Betti types across every subgroup: empty20, acyclic105, H0 rank1 ten, H1 rank2 five, H2 rank2 fifteen. The F2 test corroborates but does not prove the integral two-sphere wedge; the reviewed face collapse and pi1 argument do.
